_comment: ARENA-0 (TASKS ARENA-0, .claude/re/PROJECT_SCOPE.md §Arena): warps for the Arena mode. Applied to event/common.emevd.dcx by scripts/build-gamedata.ps1. warp = [area, block, region, index] of the target map, entity = a point in it (Warp Player 2003:93, as the Spirit Shelter's m12 event 12002099 uses to send the party to the Nightlord: 18 / 18002200 for the Night Aspect card). Per game: our flag 10007500 ON warps this game's player to Heolstor's arena (m18_00_00_00, 18002200), then the flag is cleared and the event waits again (dev console: flag 10007500 1).
